author: BlancoFS
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds some missing HLT filters to the MUO@POG NanoAOD, useful to compute efficiencies for the low-PU runs of 2026. The scope of the PR is to have this information in NanoAODv16.

Tagging (@CeliaFernandez )

Backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52355 to CMSSW_17_1_X
title: Add new muon filters for HLT low-pu triggers (backport of #52355)
